Class SentenceAnalyzerTest

java.lang.Object
it.unipd.nonsense.utils.SentenceAnalyzerTest
public class SentenceAnalyzerTest extends Object
Unit tests for the SentenceAnalyzer class. Verifies functionality including syntax analysis, word categorization, language detection, and toxicity scoring capabilities of the analyzer.
